name: Changedetection.io
tagline: Provides free, open-source web page monitoring, notification and change detection.
description: Changedetection.io provides free, open-source web page monitoring, notification and change detection.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/changedetection.io:0.60.9@sha256:902d7df0205f5c92b6f18b3f56a99e24d451ec5803cd2b231bb292b77e074424
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      BASE_URL: ''
      PLAYWRIGHT_DRIVER_URL: ''
    ports:
      - target: 5000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
